coverage.note: [Fe/H] ceiling +1 — NO metal-rich clamp; covers the 55 Cnc regime (~+0.3). Departure coefficients are per energy level, so the grid covers ALL S I lines — the optical 6743/6757 multiplet AND the NIR 9212/9228/9237 triplet — making the optical-vs-NIR indicator a per-target line-quality choice, not a grid-availability constraint (supersedes the RYA-401 S verdict; S flips LTE-flagged -> GET-GRID, PUBLISHED).
